when: a platform notice titled "Approval requested" with a body and an approval link, sent to a Discord chat
expect: the bridge sends one embed signed by the platform with the link as a button

when: the same notice sent to a Slack channel
expect: the bridge sends blocks naming the platform, the title, the body in plain text and a link button

when: the same notice sent to a Telegram chat
expect: the bridge sends a bold heading naming the platform and the title, the body quoted, and the link in a button

when: the same notice sent to a Google Chat space
expect: the bridge sends a card with the title in the header, the platform as sender and a link button

when: a notice whose link Discord would refuse as a button
expect: the address is spelled out in the body

when: a tool of the assistant has run for "4" seconds in a chat conversation
expect: one status message appears with the catalogue's sentence for that step

when: every tool of a turn finishes within "4" seconds
expect: no status message is posted for the turn

when: a status line is up and tools start after it in quick succession
expect: the same message is edited in place at most once every 1.5 seconds and shows the latest step, and it is deleted when the turn ends

when: the status line of a Discord direct message is put up
expect: it is one silent message, edited in place and deleted at the end

when: the status line of a Telegram conversation is put up
expect: it is one message sent without a notification, edited in place and deleted

when: the catalogue cannot answer for a tool
expect: the line carries the bridge's plain sentence in the conversation's language

when: a Discord notice quotes a sender as "Erin <erin@example.com>" in its text
expect: the address reaches the chat with its closing bracket and no escape character, and only a quote sign opening a line is escaped

when: a caller with the shared secret posts "/internal/notice/close" with an assistant, a notice reference, the notice and "✓ Approvata"
expect: the answer is 200 closed and the assistant's channel is asked to close that notice with those words

when: /internal/notice/close is posted with "Bearer wrong"
expect: the answer is 401 and nothing is closed

when: /internal/notice/close is posted with a reference lacking its message, a notice without a link or title, empty closing words, or no assistant
expect: the answer is 400 and nothing is closed

when: /internal/notice/close is posted for an assistant whose channel cannot close a notice
expect: the answer is 409

when: /internal/notice/close is posted and the channel refuses the edit with "Bad Request: message to edit not found"
expect: the answer is 502 carrying the channel's reason

when: the bridge closes a Discord approval notice sent as several messages
expect: the reference it returns names the last message, which carries the button

when: a Discord approval notice is closed with "✓ Approvata"
expect: the edit sends only the components, with a button labelled "✓ Approvata" that carries the approval's link and is not disabled

when: a Slack approval notice is closed with "✕ Rifiutata"
expect: the message is updated in the direct message Slack named, and its button reads "✕ Rifiutata" and still opens the approval's link

when: a Telegram approval notice is closed with "Scaduta"
expect: the message is edited with an inline button labelled "Scaduta" that still opens the approval's link

when: a Google Chat approval notice is closed with "✓ Approvata"
expect: the card is replaced in place with its button reading "✓ Approvata", not disabled, and carrying the approval's link
